meta.name: domain-modeling
meta.description: Build and sharpen a project's domain model. Use when the user wants to pin down domain terminology or a ubiquitous language, record an architectural decision, or when another skill needs to maintain the domain model.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 梳理并精炼项目的领域模型与通用语言
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在构建或维护复杂业务系统的领域模型
copy.tagline_en: Refine and sharpen your project's domain model and ubiquitous language
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building or maintaining a domain model for a complex business system

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会主动帮你梳理项目中的专业术语，发现用词矛盾时立刻指出，并用精确的词汇替换模糊说法。它还会在讨论中设计边界案例来检验概念，并实时更新术语表。
howto.when: 当你想明确项目术语、记录架构决策，或需要维护领域模型时触发。

say.text: 我们说的“订单取消”到底指什么？
say.note: Claude 会检查术语表并指出矛盾。

say.text: 帮我理清“用户”和“客户”的区别。
say.note: Claude 会提出精确术语并更新文档。

say.text: 这个订单部分取消的场景怎么建模？
say.note: Claude 会设计边界案例来检验概念。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude actively helps you clarify project terminology, immediately points out contradictions, replaces vague terms with precise ones, stress-tests concepts with edge-case scenarios, and updates the glossary in real time.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to pin down domain terminology, record an architectural decision, or maintain the domain model.

say_en.text: What exactly do we mean by 'order cancellation'?
say_en.note: Claude checks the glossary and points out contradictions.
Claude proposes precise terms and updates the document.

say_en.text: How should we model partial order cancellation?
say_en.note: Claude designs edge-case scenarios to test concepts.
